content.title: Free Flu Shots - Schedule Flu Shot Appointments | Walgreens
content.text: Who should get a flu shot? Pretty much everyone. Most people 6 months and older should get a flu shot. We vaccinate those 3 years and up, and we have CDC-recommended flu shots for adults 65+. Our pharmacists are here to help make it easy. Walk in or schedule online today. Schedule now your flu shot for everyone 6 months and older More than one vaccine, more peace of mind. Flu, COVID-19, RSV, pneumococcal—these are just some of the vaccines our pharmacists can help you stay up to date on. Whether you need one or a few, we’ll walk you through your options and make it easy to get what you need, when you need it. Vaccines take about 2 weeks to become fully effective, so don’t wait. Schedule now your flu shot for peace of mind Not feeling your best? You’re in the right place. Our pharmacists are here to help when you need it most. They can offer flu and COVID-19 testing, treatment, and recommend over-the-counter relief products depending on the results. Our pharmacists know a lot about the flu. See what our pharmacists have to say about flu shots and how to help stay protected. Looking for more resources?Frequently Asked Questions Get answers to your questions about Flu shots.
